Name: Aeneas
Summary: Aeneas had been bedridden with palsy for eight years at Lydda when Peter found him and said, Aeneas, Jesus Christ makes you whole. He arose immediately, and all Lydda and Sharon turned to the Lord.
KeyStory: Aeneas lay eight years on a bed, and rose at a sentence, and two towns turned to the Lord.
LifeLesson: Eight years of paralysis ended in one command. Aeneas rose, and his neighbours saw and believed.
